relationships.headline: Colombian Air Force space program (FACSAT-3) — National Charter Enterprise wet-lease pitch + near-term microsat flight-test on the 2027 BLK3 campaign

Near-term microsat flight-test — fly a FACSAT-3-class microsat as a payload on the early-2027 (Mar/Apr) Spaceport America BLK3 campaign; 135 kg to 100 km, 25 in dia x 38-48 in bay; ~$75K for a 10 kg flight test per the exosaero.com payload calculator; returns payload ~25 min later for failure analysis → ~TRL 8.

Saenz is assistant engineer on FACSAT-3, which is transitioning from nanosat (FACSAT-1 3U/2018, FACSAT-2 6U) to a microsat adding a NEW propulsion subsystem — they explicitly need training + thermal-vacuum/space qualification, which is exactly the NCE + suborbital flight-test value prop. FAC research lines: satellite platforms, spatial-data exploitation, mission-control SW, space domain awareness, satcom, and AIV (assembly-integration-verification). State Dept approval for the transfer estimated ~2 months (same as the Italy/Sardinia precedent). ⚠ ITAR/EAR/TAA/MLA + securities-adjacent framing — gov/foreign-national channel, route through Jon; nothing auto-sent.
relationships.next_step: Jon to send (1) the non-ITAR NCE PowerPoint deck and (2) the Super Mod VTVL video + his contact info. Colombia (Maj. Saenz) to review internally with the Space Operations Dept and R&D Dept. Then schedule follow-up on TAA/MLA path + specific FACSAT-3 payload requirements.
